# THE POST-CANCEL RETURN (the [22:18] capture that followed the [21:57] one).
#
# The client cancelled Thursday's visit for the Олимпико house (EB 62) and the
# farewell promised «Ќе бидеме во контакт». Twelve minutes later he wrote back
# asking for another day — and the chat sat in `terminated`, where every word
# after a cancellation was answered with absolute silence until the TTL. A
# cancellation releases the chat: it does not mute the client.
#
# Their words decide what the chat re-opens as. «може друг ден?» is about
# SEEING THAT VISIT — the scheduling lane re-asks for a term (the re-book). A
# message that states NEW criteria is a new enquiry and re-opens fresh (see
# post-cancel-new-enquiry.txt): resuming the visit lane for it would put the
# OLD Евидентен број back in front of the owner — the [21:57] wrong-property
# class.
!state visit_scheduling
!eb 62
!owner 62 Петре 070111222
!arranged 62 четврток во 18:00
[22:06] КЛИЕНТ: NE MOZAM, OTKAZETE JA POSETATA
[22:18] КЛИЕНТ: A MOZE DRUG DEN?
# EXPECT cancel 62
# EXPECT no-silence
# EXPECT last-mentions термин
# EXPECT final-state visit_scheduling
